description: Multi-rider real-time scenario verification against user story specifications in prd.json with 5-tier task verification (Syntax, Types, Lint, Tests, Build/Bundle) for convoy ride orchestration.

userStories.title: Smart Airbag Vest Peripheral Bluetooth Bridge
userStories.description: As a motorcycle rider wearing a smart airbag vest (In&motion, Alpinestars Tech-Air, Helite, Dainese), I want instant BLE deployment detection to escalate directly to the emergency SOS pipeline with sub-150ms latency.
acceptanceCriteria: Detects In&motion, Alpinestars Tech-Air, Helite e-Vest, and Dainese D-air peripherals via BLE UUID and model heuristics
Triggers SafetyService.externalImpact(source: ExternalImpactSource.wearable, g: 6.0) immediately upon deployment signal
Strict immunity to false positives on low battery warnings and firmware update / OTA modes
Renders dynamic HUD pill in cockpit with connection state, battery percentage, and armed status
flutter test test/services/smart_airbag_bridge_service_test.dart passes cleanly with 0 failures
userStories.notes: Verified 23/23 tests passing with sub-150ms latency execution path.

userStories.title: Server-Side Emergency SMS & WhatsApp Web Gateway Fallback
userStories.description: As a stranded rider whose phone is data-only or on iOS where background SMS is restricted, I want distress signals to trigger cloud-dispatched SMS and WhatsApp messages with live tracking links.
acceptanceCriteria: Exposes POST /api/v1/sos/dispatch-external on gateway microservice
Integrates Twilio, Infobip, WhatsApp Cloud API, and webhook fallback with E.164 phone normalization
ServerEmergencyGatewayService routes SOS seamlessly on iOS or when native SIM is missing
Outbox resilience queue guarantees zero signal loss on unconfigured or failing providers
flutter test test/services/server_emergency_gateway_service_test.dart and npm test pass cleanly
userStories.notes: Verified 10/10 Dart unit tests and 338/338 Node gateway tests passing cleanly.

userStories.title: Highway Tunnel Entry Dead Reckoning Takeover
userStories.description: As a rider entering a mountain highway tunnel (e.g., Atal Tunnel 9.02 km) with sudden GPS loss, I want the dead reckoning engine to smoothly project my location along the route and suppress false stopped alarms.
acceptanceCriteria: Detects tunnel entry via GPS accuracy degradation (>50m) or fix age (>3s) while moving on active route
Smooth along-route projection using exponential speed decay v(t) = v0 * exp(-alpha * t) for up to 720s
Suppresses false 'Rider Stopped' and 'Rider Separated' alarms during tunnel coasting
Halts dead reckoning at crash impact point if accelerometer registers severe impact (>4.0G)
Smoothly re-converges to recovered GPS fix upon tunnel exit over 4s without teleportation jumps
flutter test test/tracking/dead_reckoning_integration_test.dart passes cleanly

userStories.title: Glove-Friendly Cockpit Operation in Extreme Sunlight & Pouring Rain
userStories.description: As a motorcyclist riding in harsh outdoor conditions, I want high-contrast UI with oversized touch targets so I can safely operate controls with thick gloves.
acceptanceCriteria: All critical interactive controls enforce minimum 48-56dp touch targets
Emergency SOS button enforces 56-60dp touch target with press-and-hold activation to prevent rain false triggers
Cockpit speedometer provides big bold tabular readouts with high-contrast OLED styling
Safety settings screen provides clear status badges and accessible 48dp thumb rows
flutter test test/screens/ passes cleanly

userStories.title: Peer-to-Peer Wi-Fi Direct & Convoy Mesh Fallback
userStories.description: As a convoy member riding through cellular dead zones, I want local peer-to-peer mesh networking to sync rider telemetry and broadcast distress alerts.
acceptanceCriteria: Multi-hop packet relay forwards telemetry frames with decremented TTL and incremented hopCount
Local emergency SOS beacon propagates instantly across local mesh nodes
Teammate offline SOS distress renders on action stack and updates ConvoyService
flutter test test/p2p_mesh_service_test.dart and test/convoy_mesh_integration_test.dart pass cleanly
userStories.notes: Verified 9/9 mesh unit & integration tests passing cleanly.

userStories.title: Sub-Cluster Toll Plaza Split & Separation Alarm Suppression (REQ-11)
userStories.description: As a convoy pack experiencing a physical split at a highway toll plaza or bottleneck, I want the system to calculate sub-cluster gaps and suppress false individual separation spam while tracking lead/trail group distances.
acceptanceCriteria: Calculates along-route gap distance between Lead cluster and Trail cluster accurately
Emits CONVOY_SPLIT alert to Lead rider indicating trail pack lag distance
Suppresses false 'Rider Separated' spam for riders stationary at known toll barriers or in clusters
Verified by scenario_convoy_dynamics_test.dart and scenario_d_convoy_split_test.dart
userStories.notes: Passed REQ-11 tests in Flutter and Gateway test suites.

userStories.title: Dynamic Rendezvous Protocol & Regrouping (REQ-12)
userStories.description: As a Road Captain managing a split convoy, I want to broadcast dynamic rendezvous points with convergence tracking so separated clusters regroup within 150m without manual coordination.
acceptanceCriteria: Road Captain broadcasts dynamic rendezvous stop marker to active convoy
Riders track convergence distance along route corridor to rendezvous point
Automatically marks rendezvous complete and dissolves split state when riders arrive within 150m
Verified by scenario_convoy_dynamics_test.dart and scenario_convoy.test.js
userStories.notes: Passed REQ-12 rendezvous tests in Flutter and Gateway test suites.

userStories.title: Sweeper Distress Detection & Reverse Escalation to Lead (REQ-13)
userStories.description: As the convoy lead, I want immediate reverse escalation alerts if the tail sweeper halts or loses telemetry while the rest of the pack continues riding.
acceptanceCriteria: Detects sweeper halt (speed 0 km/h or offline >60s) while pack is in motion
Triggers high-priority SWEEPER_DISTRESS alert on Lead rider cockpit HUD
Sweeper distress clears immediately upon sweeper resuming speed or manual acknowledgment
Verified by scenario_convoy_dynamics_test.dart and sweeper.test.js
userStories.notes: Passed REQ-13 sweeper distress tests in Flutter and Gateway test suites.

userStories.title: Lost Rider Homing Vectors & Route Intercept Recovery (REQ-14)
userStories.description: As a rider who missed a turn and separated from the convoy, I want offline homing vectors pointing back to the route corridor and sweeper backtrack intercept.
acceptanceCriteria: Calculates shortest perpendicular homing vector to active route corridor
Provides cardinal direction, bearing, and distance to nearest route point offline
Computes sweeper backtrack intercept point for efficient group reunion
Verified by scenario_convoy_dynamics_test.dart
userStories.notes: Passed REQ-14 lost rider recovery tests.

userStories.title: High-Jitter Patchy Cellular Network & Idempotent Emergency Delivery (Scenario B)
userStories.description: As a rider navigating rural highways with 500ms-2000ms latency and 30% packet loss, I want telemetry filtering to discard jittery teleported fixes and guarantee idempotent SOS delivery.
acceptanceCriteria: TrackFilter strictly rejects out-of-order, duplicate, and teleported fixes (>180 km/h jump)
ConvoyService deduplicates chat messages and socket frames over flaky connections
Local SOS outbox queues distress signals offline and confirms idempotently upon reconnection
Verified by scenario_b_high_jitter_network_test.dart and scenario_convoy.test.js
userStories.notes: Passed Scenario B high-jitter network tests.

userStories.title: Low Battery Critical Throttle & Power Conservation (Scenario C)
userStories.description: As a rider whose phone reaches critical battery (<15%), I want the app to halve telemetry polling and throttle non-essential network updates while preserving life safety tracking.
acceptanceCriteria: Enters battery conservation mode at <=15% battery with hysteresis clearing at >=20%
Throttles moving telemetry interval to 5s and stationary interval to 30s
Preserves emergency SOS and crash detection at full priority regardless of battery state
Verified by scenario_c_low_battery_throttle_test.dart
userStories.notes: Passed Scenario C battery throttling tests.

userStories.title: Concurrent Multi-Incident Emergency Handling & Responder Isolation (Scenario E)
userStories.description: As an emergency dispatcher or convoy lead, I want concurrent crash alarms and manual SOS events to be tracked independently with isolated responder allocations.
acceptanceCriteria: Prioritizes crash impact alarms over concurrent manual SOS events on cockpit HUD
Tracks responder assignments independently per incident without IDOR or state collision
Resolving one incident leaves concurrent active incidents in open emergency state
Verified by scenario_e_multi_incident_alarm_test.dart and scenario_convoy.test.js

userStories.title: Convoy Dissolution & Multi-Client Session Synchronization
userStories.description: As a convoy member or admin, I want ride termination by the admin to dissolve active convoy sessions cleanly across all rider devices without orphaned state.
acceptanceCriteria: When DISSOLVED frame arrives, ConvoyService immediately clears active convoy state and notifies listeners
Terminates active background location recording and resets cockpit HUD
Prevents orphaned session references or ghost riders in local storage
Verified by chat_and_end_ride_test.dart and convoy_network_test.dart
userStories.notes: Passed ride dissolution and multi-client synchronization tests.
